title: fix(code-mode): preserve injected namespace values under heap pressure
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Code Mode can silently replace injected arrays with text when QuickJS exhausts its heap while initializing namespace values.

## User Impact

Injected state preserves its complete structure or fails visibly before later tools execute. Existing normalization, host detachment and headless deep freezing remain in place.

## Why This Change Was Made

Namespace producers already normalize values, and initialization transfers them into the guest. The controller copied each leaf again through JSON; its broad fallback converted an allocation failure into `String(array)`. Consume the guest-owned value directly.

This removes the redundant serialization/parse cycle. No dependency, configuration, memory-limit or executor-default changes. Production delta: +1 comment line; tests: +83 lines. The separately reproduced QuickJS catalog-constructor corruption remains a dependency follow-up.

## Evidence

- Before: 100,000 indexed rows at a 16 MiB guest heap became a string of length 1,599,999, reported completion and executed the sentinel tool. At 128 MiB every row was intact.
- After: all 72 focused tests passed across QuickJS integration, headless execution, Node/QuickJS checkpoint parity and MCP namespace contracts in [Testbox run 41022575242](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41022575242), source tree `52f317cddc16b5bce795f2d6cb8b319c4c52465c`. The pressure regression requires complete data or visible failure before the sentinel.
- Both engines retain normalized, detached, deeply frozen nested state across repeated runs. Earlier reply-decoding OOM regressions also pass.
- Independent autoreview of the complete local candidate against `d67aa608643f6583a6c6102c522043794aafe064`: scoped-clean through P2. It inspected canonical producers, VM ingress and freezing; tests were executed separately.
- Targeted formatting and diff checks passed. Initial PR CI found three test-only lint errors; `a7270d6288c` replaces bare `NaN` with `Number.NaN` and renames a shadowing loop variable. Production code and test assertions are unchanged. Fresh [exact-head PR CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41024610266) passed on `a7270d6288c77d4bbef1bfca1753406c92fcb7eb`, including production/test types, core/plugin lint, source guards and changed-test lanes. A queued static-check Testbox was stopped. These are correctness results, with no new performance or ShellBench claim.
